d: We are a digital assets trading firm, applying for a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) license from Dubai’s Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA). We are looking for a hands-on Compliance Officer / MLRO who will also oversee the firm's risk management function, subject to regulatory approval.
q: At least 5 years of relevant experience in a compliance function, including 2 years handling AML/CFT matters.
Good knowledge of AML/CFT regulations and compliance requirements.
Eligible to meet VARA's Fit and Proper requirements.
Experience in financial services, fintech or digital assets; previous VARA experience is a plus.
UAE resident or UAE passport holder, or able to satisfy the UAE regulatory and residency requirements applicable to the role.
r: Maintain and implement compliance policies and procedures in line with VARA and UAE laws.
Monitor ongoing compliance and coordinate reporting and communications with VARA.
Coordinate compliance training for staff and senior management.
Prepare compliance reports and audit updates for the Board.
Maintain the firm's AML/CFT policies, procedures and risk assessments.
Oversee and perform transaction monitoring, client due diligence, sanctions screening, and FATF Travel Rule compliance processes.
Provide regular updates and reports to the Board.
Assist management in building and running the firm's risk-management framework.
Maintain the risk register and assist with the implementation of risk management procedures.
Prepare risk exposure reports for the Board identifying actual and potential risks, and additional reports where necessary.
x: Please submit your CV below, along with answers to two questions
Please give a brief, high-level summary of your compliance and AML/CFT experience.
Do you have any experience with virtual assets or the VARA licensing process? If yes, please give a brief summary.

d: Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

You independently operate and maintain at least one process, equipment or systems following autonomous maintenance (AM) standards and use your technical skills to improve line and/or system performance to meet business needs.
q: A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
Safety and quality standards for operating machines
Reading and writing, and fluently conversant in the language of communication as appropriate to the site
Collaborating well in a diverse work environment
What you need to know about this position

Mondelēz International in the Middle East, North Africa and Pakistan serves the Middle East and Africa markets as well as Australia, New Zealand, the UK and Canada. Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we have more than 2600 employees working across seven plants and six commercial offices; we make, bake, sell and deliver our products to customers. We are market leaders in key snacking categories with iconic global and local brands including Cadbury Dairy Milk chocolate, Milka, Oreo and belVita biscuits, Barni Cakes,Tang powdered beverage, Chiclets and Trident gum and Halls candy.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
r: You are a key ingredient in changing how the world snacks. With coaching, you will operate and maintain equipment to deliver on our safety, quality, cost, delivery, sustainability and morale targets. You will use execute all standard work processes on your equipment using AM (autonomous maintenance) and PM (progressive maintenance) standards and ensure that safety processes are observed, and that quality assurance activities are performed. You will understand the losses in their area and equipment and report them.
